name: Women's Christian College
summary: Women's Christian College was founded in 1915, has been autonomous since 1982 and is affiliated to the University of Madras. NAAC re-accredited it with an A+ grade in July 2025. Undergraduate courses run in a government-aided stream and a self-financed stream, including a five-year integrated M.Sc. in Computer Science & Technology.

applicationPlatform.value: WCC online application (open from 24 April 2026 for 2026–27)

admission.eligibility: Pass in the Higher Secondary (+2) examination or equivalent.

process.detail: Application forms for 2026–27 were available online from 24 April 2026.
